points.title: 军校生涯
points.description: 保卢斯进入布雷斯劳的普鲁士军官学校学习，开始了他的军事生涯。在这里，他接受了系统的军事训练，学习了战术、战略和军事历史等课程。这段经历为他后来的军事生涯奠定了坚实基础，也培养了他对军事纪律和服从的深刻理解。保卢斯在军校期间表现优异，展现出对军事理论的浓厚兴趣和分析能力。
points.descriptionEn: Paulus entered the Prussian War School in Breslau, beginning his military career. Here, he received systematic military training, studying tactics, strategy, and military history. This experience laid a solid foundation for his later military career and cultivated his deep understanding of military discipline and obedience. Paulus performed excellently during his time at the academy, showing a strong interest in military theory and analytical skills.

points.title: 一战服役
points.description: 第一次世界大战爆发后，保卢斯作为中尉在西线战场服役。他参与了凡尔登战役、索姆河战役等重要战斗，表现出色并多次获得晋升。这段经历使他对现代战争的残酷性有了深刻认识，同时也积累了宝贵的实战经验。战争结束后，保卢斯选择留在军队，成为德国国防军的一员，这为他后来在二战中的角色埋下伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of World War I, Paulus served as a lieutenant on the Western Front. He participated in major battles such as the Battle of Verdun and the Battle of the Somme, performing exceptionally well and receiving multiple promotions. This experience gave him a profound understanding of the brutality of modern warfare and accumulated valuable practical experience. After the war, Paulus chose to remain in the army, becoming a member of the Reichswehr, which laid the groundwork for his later role in World War II.

points.title: 参谋晋升
points.description: 二战爆发后，保卢斯迅速在德国国防军中晋升。1939年，他成为陆军总参谋部的一名高级参谋，参与了波兰战役和法国战役的策划工作。1940年，他被任命为第10集团军参谋长，协助指挥德军在巴尔干地区的行动。1941年，他参与制定了入侵苏联的'巴巴罗萨计划'。在柏林期间，保卢斯展现出卓越的军事才能和组织能力，赢得了希特勒的赏识，为后来被任命为第6集团军司令奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of World War II, Paulus rapidly rose through the ranks of the German Wehrmacht. In 1939, he became a senior staff officer in the Army High Command, participating in the planning of the Polish and French campaigns. In 1940, he was appointed Chief of Staff of the 10th Army, assisting in the command of German operations in the Balkans. In 1941, he participated in the planning of Operation Barbarossa, the invasion of the Soviet Union. During his time in Berlin, Paulus demonstrated outstanding military talent and organizational skills, earning Hitler's appreciation and laying the foundation for his later appointment as commander of the 6th Army.

points.title: 斯大林格勒战役
points.description: 1942年，保卢斯被任命为第6集团军司令，负责执行'蓝色方案'中的关键部分——夺取斯大林格勒。他指挥德军攻入城市，并与苏军展开残酷的巷战。然而，随着苏军的包围圈逐渐收紧，保卢斯面临艰难抉择。尽管他多次请求希特勒允许突围，但均被拒绝。1943年2月，保卢斯在弹尽粮绝、伤员众多的情况下，不顾希特勒要求'战斗到最后一兵一卒'的命令，选择投降，成为二战中德国第一位投降的元帅级将领。这一决定被视为对希特勒盲目忠诚的反抗，也是对军人责任的重新诠释。
points.descriptionEn: In 1942, Paulus was appointed commander of the 6th Army, responsible for executing a key part of 'Case Blue' – the capture of Stalingrad. He led the German army into the city and engaged in brutal street fighting with Soviet forces. However, as the Soviet encirclement tightened, Paulus faced a difficult decision. Despite repeatedly requesting Hitler's permission to break out, his requests were denied. In February 1943, with ammunition exhausted and casualties mounting, Paulus chose to surrender despite Hitler's orders to 'fight to the last man,' becoming the first field marshal-grade German general to surrender in WWII. This decision was seen as a rebellion against blind loyalty to Hitler and a reinterpretation of military responsibility.

points.title: 战后岁月
points.description: 投降后，保卢斯被苏联囚禁，在战俘营中度过了五年。1953年，他被提前释放并返回东德。在苏联期间，保卢斯参与了'国家委员会'，呼吁德国军队反对希特勒和纳粹政权。回到东德后，他定居于德累斯顿，撰写回忆录并参与反法西斯活动。保卢斯晚年对斯大林格勒战役进行了反思，承认自己作为指挥官的责任，同时也批评希特勒的军事决策。1957年，保卢斯在德累斯顿去世，终年67岁。他的墓碑上刻着'我服从了我的良心'，体现了他对自己人生选择的最终态度。
points.descriptionEn: After surrendering, Paulus was imprisoned by the Soviet Union and spent five years as a prisoner of war. In 1953, he was released early and returned to East Germany. During his time in the Soviet Union, Paulus participated in the 'National Committee' calling on the German army to oppose Hitler and the Nazi regime. After returning to East Germany, he settled in Dresden, writing memoirs and participating in anti-fascist activities. In his later years, Paulus reflected on the Battle of Stalingrad, acknowledging his responsibility as a commander while also criticizing Hitler's military decisions. Paulus died in Dresden in 1957 at the age of 67. His tombstone is inscribed with 'I obeyed my conscience,' reflecting his final attitude toward the choices he made in his life.

supporter.zh: 支持者认为保卢斯是一位有良知的军人，他在斯大林格勒战役中做出了勇敢的决定，选择投降而非让士兵无谓牺牲。这一决定被视为对希特勒盲目忠诚的反抗，体现了军人真正的责任——保护士兵的生命。战后，他积极参与反法西斯活动，承认自己的责任并反思历史，展现了一位正直军人的品格。保卢斯的行动被视为德国军队中少数敢于抵抗希特勒意志的例子，为后来的德国民主化进程提供了道德支持。
supporter.en: Supporters view Paulus as a conscientious officer who made a brave decision during the Battle of Stalingrad, choosing to surrender rather than let his soldiers sacrifice needlessly. This decision is seen as a rebellion against blind loyalty to Hitler, reflecting the true responsibility of a soldier—to protect the lives of his men. After the war, he actively participated in anti-fascist activities, acknowledged his responsibility, and reflected on history, demonstrating the character of an upright officer. Paulus's actions are considered an example of the few in the German army who dared to resist Hitler's will, providing moral support for Germany's later democratization process.

critic.zh: 批评者认为保卢斯作为高级将领，在斯大林格勒战役中犯了严重错误。他们指责他过于机械地执行希特勒的命令，未能及时预见到苏军的包围意图，导致第6集团军被歼灭。批评者还指出，保卢斯在投降前没有尽最大努力组织突围，辜负了士兵的信任。此外，有人质疑他在战后的立场转变是否真诚，认为他可能是在苏联压力下才批评纳粹政权。批评者认为保卢斯缺乏独立军事判断力，是德国军事传统中盲目服从的典型代表。
critic.en: Critics argue that as a high-ranking general, Paulus made serious mistakes during the Battle of Stalingrad. They accuse him of mechanically executing Hitler's orders without timely foreseeing the Soviet encirclement intentions, leading to the annihilation of the 6th Army. Critics also point out that Paulus did not do his utmost to organize a breakout before surrendering, betraying his soldiers' trust. Additionally, some question the sincerity of his post-war stance shift, suggesting he may have criticized the Nazi regime under Soviet pressure. Critics believe Paulus lacked independent military judgment and represents the blind obedience typical of German military tradition.

objective.zh: 从历史学角度看，保卢斯是一个复杂而矛盾的历史人物。他既是德国军事传统的产物，又在关键时刻表现出独立思考。斯大林格勒战役成为二战转折点，保卢斯的投降象征着纳粹德国军事神话的破灭。在流行文化中，保卢斯常被描绘为在个人良知与国家忠诚之间挣扎的形象。历史学界普遍认为，保卢斯的行为反映了当时德国军队内部的分裂，以及军人面对极权政权时的道德困境。他的经历成为研究二战中德国军事决策和军人责任的重要案例。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Paulus is a complex and contradictory figure. He was both a product of German military tradition and showed independent thinking at a critical moment. The Battle of Stalingrad became a turning point in WWII, and Paulus's surrender symbolized the collapse of the Nazi German military myth. In popular culture, Paulus is often depicted as struggling between personal conscience and national loyalty. Historiography generally holds that Paulus's actions reflect the divisions within the German army at the time and the moral dilemmas faced by soldiers when confronted with totalitarian regimes. His experience has become an important case study for studying German military decision-making and military responsibility during WWII.

others.zh: 保卢斯是德国军队中唯一一个有勇气说'不'的人。
others.en: Paulus was the only man in the German army who had the courage to say 'no'.
